items.summary: Site Factory disposition: maintain a bounded, preview-only pipeline for complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net using their existing readiness work. The strongest candidate is complicated.work, tied at score 84 and already scaffolded. Do not add domains, spend, deploy, publish, or launch. Its reusable launch packet must contain: site brief and owner, template scope, source-backed content seed, SEO metadata/sitemap baseline, analytics and affiliate readiness with attribution boundaries, legal/compliance checklist, security evidence, measurement plan, rollback point, and explicit launch gate. Capacity is saturated and readiness evidence is incomplete, so implementation admission remains blocked.
